experiment: Four-class concept learning under Sudoku rules (Appendix G.9)
task: Each training example is a 4x4 Sudoku board whose 16 cells are distinct CIFAR-10 images of four classes (airplane, automobile, bird, cat). The supervision consists of the row, column and 2x2-block rules and, on a fraction of the boards, the class of the top-left cell; the revealed cells cycle over the four classes.
pools: Per class, one seeded permutation of the CIFAR-10 training images of that class; training set k uses images 1000k to 1000k+999 of each permutation, so the four training sets are disjoint. Test boards use CIFAR-10 test images.
model: torchvision ResNet-18 with IMAGENET1K_V1 weights and a new four-class output layer; images are resized bilinearly from 32x32 to the input size; all parameters are trained; batch normalization uses batch statistics during updates and running statistics for evaluation; no augmentation
optimizer: Adam with default moment coefficients, no weight decay, constant step size
objective: Cross-entropy against the exact posterior over the legal completions of each board (288, or 72 given a revealed cell), with a uniform prior and unit temperature
reference: The same network trained on the true class of every cell, with the same boards, minibatches and epochs
pairing: Within a training set and seed, every setting shares the initial network, the boards and the minibatch order
